latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 falsus、fallere 与 falsitas 解释了 false 及其词族。

items.example: They proved the falsity of the claim.
items.exampleCN: 他们证明了这个说法的虚假。

items.example: The report was full of falsehoods.

items.meaning: a warning that turns out to be untrue
items.example: The fire was a false alarm.
She booked the room under a false name.
He removed his false teeth at night.

items.meaning: a person who is not a true friend
items.example: A false friend is worse than an enemy.

latinEntries.exampleCN: falsus 演变为英语 false。

latinEntries.example: Fallere is the root of falsus.
latinEntries.exampleCN: fallere 是 falsus 的词根。
falsitas 演变为英语 falsity。

definition_zh: 名声；名望；声誉
definition_en: the state of being widely known and talked about; the reputation a person or thing has among people
core_image: 一个人的名字被无数人同时念起
scene: 她一夜之间成名。She rose to fame overnight.
sceneCN: 这里 fame 是「名声、名望」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她一夜之间成名。

senses.title: Being widely known
senses.definition: the state of being widely known and talked about
senses.definitionCN: 被广泛知晓和谈论的状态
senses.example: The singer achieved fame at nineteen.
senses.exampleCN: 这位歌手十九岁就成名了。
senses.why: The core sense is a name carried by many voices.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是一个被众人传诵的名字。

senses.title: Public reputation
senses.definition: the reputation a person or thing has among people
senses.definitionCN: 人或事物在公众中的声誉
senses.example: The school enjoys fame for its music.
senses.exampleCN: 这所学校因音乐而享有声誉。
senses.why: What people say becomes the standing of a person or place.
senses.whyCN: 众人的说法形成人或地方的声望。

intro.en: Fame comes from Latin fama, report or reputation, from fari, to speak.
intro.cn: fame 来自拉丁语 fama（传闻、声誉），源头 fari（说话）。

items.en: Fari means to speak.
items.cn: fari 意为说话。

items.en: Fama means report or reputation.
items.cn: fama 意为传闻或声誉。

items.en: Fame carries the sense of renown.
items.cn: fame 带有名望之义。

items.en: Fame means public report and honour.
items.cn: 中古英语中 fame 指公众传闻与荣誉。

items.en: Fame means wide recognition.
items.cn: 现代英语中 fame 意为广泛认可。

note.en: Fame is wide recognition; a frame is a border.
note.cn: fame 是名声，frame 则是框架。

normalIntro.en: Fame is what happens when many people say your name.
normalIntro.cn: fame 就是许多人念起你名字时的状态。

normal.en: The band rose to fame in the nineties.
normal.cn: 这支乐队九十年代成名。

normal.en: She cares more about her work than about fame.
normal.cn: 她更在意作品而非名声。

normal.en: The town's claim to fame is its old bridge.
normal.cn: 这座镇子出名的资本是那座古桥。

normal.en: Fame and fortune did not make him happy.
The scientist won international fame.
normal.cn: 这位科学家赢得了国际声誉。

abstract.en: Picture thousands of people reading one name.
abstract.cn: 想象成千上万的人读着同一个名字。

abstract.en: Imagine a spotlight that never turns off.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏永不熄灭的聚光灯。

abstract.en: Think of a whisper that becomes a roar.
abstract.cn: 把名声想成由低语汇成的轰鸣。

examples.en: Her fame spread quickly after the film.
examples.cn: 电影上映后她的名声迅速传开。

examples.en: He found fame difficult to handle.
examples.cn: 他觉得名气难以应对。

examples.en: The restaurant's fame rests on one dish.
examples.cn: 这家餐厅的声誉全靠一道菜。

dict_mnemonic.note: 词源记忆 · 拉丁词根
dict_mnemonic.text: fame 与 famous、infamous 同源于拉丁语 fama（传闻），核心是「被人谈论」，好名声坏名声都由此而来。

root: fame 源自拉丁语 fama（传闻、声誉），来自 fari（说话），本义是「被人谈论」。

sensesIntro.en: Fame is the state of being widely known or the reputation one has.
sensesIntro.cn: fame 指广为人知的状态，或一个人所拥有的声誉。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one name repeated by countless voices.
core.cn: 核心意象：被无数声音重复的一个名字。

branches.en: The base sense is being widely known.
branches.cn: 基础义是广为人知。

branches.en: What people say becomes reputation.
branches.cn: 众人所言形成声誉。

branches.en: Wide recognition and good standing overlap.
branches.cn: 广泛知名与良好声望相互交叠。

branches.en: Fame can rest on deeds or on talk.
branches.cn: 名声可以来自事迹，也可以来自谈论。

branches.en: A strong reputation often brings fame.
branches.cn: 良好声誉常常带来名声。

intro.en: Fame builds famous and infamous through the -ous ending.
intro.cn: fame 通过 -ous 后缀构成 famous 与 infamous。

latinIntro.en: Latin fama, fari, and famosus explain the family of fame.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 fama、fari 与 famosus 解释了 fame 的词族。

items.example: Fame came late to the painter.
The prison was infamous for cruelty.
items.exampleCN: 这座监狱因残酷而臭名昭著。
这一行为让他背上恶名。

items.example: The region is famed for its wine.
items.exampleCN: 这个地区以葡萄酒闻名。

items.example: She rose to fame through social media.
The bridge is the town's claim to fame.
items.exampleCN: 这座桥是小镇出名的资本。

latinEntries.exampleCN: fama 演变为英语 fame。

latinEntries.example: Fari is the root of fama.
latinEntries.exampleCN: fari 是 fama 的词根。
famosus 演变为英语 famous。

definition_zh: 熟悉的；常见的；精通的；亲密的；冒昧的
definition_en: well known or easy to recognize; having good knowledge of something; friendly and informal; too informal in a way that shows disrespect
core_image: 像回到自己家里一样，每件东西都认得
scene: 这条街对我来说很熟悉。This street is familiar to me.
sceneCN: 这里 familiar 是「熟悉的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这条街对我来说很熟悉。

senses.title: Well known
senses.definition: well known or easy to recognize
senses.definitionCN: 熟知的或容易辨认的
senses.example: Her face looks familiar.
senses.exampleCN: 她的脸看起来很面熟。
senses.why: The core sense is recognizing something as known.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是把某物认作已知。

senses.title: Knowing well
senses.definition: having a good knowledge of something
senses.definitionCN: 对某事有良好了解
senses.example: Are you familiar with this software?
senses.exampleCN: 你熟悉这个软件吗？
senses.why: Recognition deepens into knowledge.
senses.whyCN: 辨认加深为知识。

senses.title: Friendly
senses.definition: friendly and informal in manner
senses.definitionCN: 态度友好随和
senses.example: He greeted us in a familiar way.
senses.exampleCN: 他以亲切的方式和我们打招呼。
senses.why: People who are close behave as if at home together.
senses.whyCN: 亲近的人相处时像同在家里一样。

senses.title: Too informal
senses.definition: too informal in a way that shows disrespect
senses.definitionCN: 过分随便而显得不尊重
senses.example: His familiar tone annoyed the manager.
senses.exampleCN: 他过分随便的语气让经理不快。
senses.why: The same closeness can cross a line.
senses.whyCN: 同样的亲昵也可能越界。

intro.en: Familiar comes from Latin familiaris, of a household, from familia, family.
intro.cn: familiar 来自拉丁语 familiaris（家庭的），源头 familia（家庭）。

items.en: Familia means a household.
items.cn: familia 意为家庭、家户。

items.en: Familiaris means of the household.
items.cn: familiaris 意为家庭的。

items.en: Familier means close or intimate.
items.cn: familier 意为亲近的。

items.en: Familiar means well known.
items.cn: 中古英语中 familiar 意为熟知的。

items.en: Familiar also means too informal.
items.cn: 现代英语中 familiar 也指过于随便。

note.en: Familiar means well known; similar means alike.
note.cn: familiar 是熟悉的，similar 则是相似的。

normalIntro.en: Familiar is the feeling of being at home with something.
normalIntro.cn: familiar 就是对某物像在家一样自在的感觉。

normal.en: The song sounded familiar.
I am not familiar with the rules.
She missed her familiar surroundings.
They are on familiar terms.
Do not be too familiar with strangers.
normal.cn: 不要对陌生人过于随便。

abstract.en: Picture walking into your own kitchen in the dark.
abstract.cn: 想象在黑暗中走进自家厨房。

abstract.en: Imagine a tune you can hum without thinking.
abstract.cn: 想象一段不用想就能哼出的旋律。

abstract.en: Think of a greeting that is warm but slightly too close.
abstract.cn: 想象一个热情却稍显越界的问候。

examples.en: The route soon became familiar.
examples.cn: 这条路线很快就变得熟悉了。

examples.en: Students should be familiar with basic grammar.
examples.cn: 学生应该熟悉基础语法。

examples.en: His familiar manner upset the guests.
examples.cn: 他过于随便的举止让客人们不快。

dict_mnemonic.note: 词源记忆 · 拉丁家庭
dict_mnemonic.text: familiar 与 family 同源于拉丁语 familia（家庭），家里的人和物最熟悉，因此 familiar 就是「像在家里一样熟」。

root: familiar 源自拉丁语 familiaris（家庭的），来自 familia（家庭），由「家中之物」引申为熟悉与亲密。

sensesIntro.en: Familiar means well known, known in detail, friendly, or too informal.
sensesIntro.cn: familiar 意为熟悉的、通晓的、亲密的，或过于随便的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the ease of moving through one's own home.
core.cn: 核心意象：在自家里行走时的自在。

branches.en: The base sense is easy recognition.
branches.cn: 基础义是容易辨认。

branches.en: Recognition deepens into knowledge.
branches.cn: 辨认加深为知识。

branches.en: Closeness produces a friendly manner.
branches.cn: 亲近产生友好的态度。

branches.en: The same closeness can become disrespect.
branches.cn: 同样的亲近可能变成失礼。

branches.en: Known people often feel like family.
branches.cn: 熟悉的人常让人觉得像家人。

intro.en: Familiar builds familiarity, familiarize, and unfamiliar.
intro.cn: familiar 构成 familiarity、familiarize 与 unfamiliar。

latinIntro.en: Latin familia and familiaris explain familiar and family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 familia 与 familiaris 解释了 familiar 与 family。

items.exampleCN: 这个地方让人感到熟悉。
培训包括熟悉环境参观。

items.example: The road was unfamiliar to us.
A familiar face waved from the crowd.
items.exampleCN: 一张熟悉的面孔从人群中挥手。

items.example: The band played a familiar tune.
items.exampleCN: 乐队演奏了一首熟悉的曲子。

latinEntries.example: Familia is the root of familiar.
latinEntries.exampleCN: familia 是 familiar 的词根。
familiaris 演变为英语 familiar。
famulus 与 familia 有关。
